name: Suspicious LNK Double Extension File Created
description: Detects the creation of files with an "LNK" as a second extension. This is sometimes used by malware as a method to abuse the fact that Windows hides the "LNK" extension by default.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Some tuning is required for other general purpose directories of third party apps
query: (file.path:*.lnk AND (file.path:(*.doc.* OR *.docx.* OR *.jpg.* OR *.pdf.* OR *.ppt.* OR *.pptx.* OR *.xls.* OR *.xlsx.*))) AND (NOT file.path:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Recent\\*) AND (NOT (((process.executable:(*\\excel.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\winword.exe)) AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Office\\Recent\\*) OR (process.executable:*\\excel.exe AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Excel*) OR (process.executable:*\\powerpnt.exe AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\PowerPoint*) OR (process.executable:*\\winword.exe AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Word*)))
